name: Derived
premise: The identity is an output of the system rather than a drawing placed beside it. The mark's proportions come from the type scale and from the measured contrast ratios, so regenerating the tokens regenerates the mark — which means the logo can never drift from the system it is supposed to represent. Colour is a wide analogous band through green and olive rather than a two-colour pair, so charts, categories and product sub-brands all have somewhere to live. This is the riskiest of the four: a generative identity is either genuinely distinctive or it ages very badly, and it is the hardest to keep disciplined once other people start using it.

ground.label: Canopy
ground.note: A deep green-black. Surfaces and text roles come from here.

accent.label: Shoot
accent.note: Olive-lime. The interactive colour, and the brightest thing in the system.

support.label: Reed
support.note: The analogous neighbour on the cool side. Secondary categories and chart series.

highlight.label: Husk
highlight.note: The analogous neighbour on the warm side. Tertiary categories and chart series.
